description:
### xx Is My Girlfriend - A series by GARDEN

"xx Is My Girlfriend" (Japanese: ○○はオレのカノジョ。) is a 64-part (+ 3 compilations) series by JAV studio GARDEN, which started with GASO-0003 in July 2014, starring Yura Sakura, and has sadly ended with GAOR-121 in July 2017, starring Aya Sazanami (Haruka Suzumiya). This is perhaps my favourite series in JAV. [b]There's no interpersonal sex in these movies[/b], just as a warning. It's all faux sex with a flesh-coloured dildo, which means that this is probably the only JAV series with decent POV (sorry, I had to). The main focus is to provide a Girlfriend Experience, occasionally modified to wife and once to pet. Essentially having a loving partner who spends a romantic day with you, both sexually and non-sexually. Non-sexual interaction includes cooking for you, having a walk through the park, or going to an arcade together, for example.

I don't think many people apart from me every ripped these films; I've uploaded 11 of them here before, but included them again for completeness' sake, since the series and studio are apparently dead. Not only that, but sadly, some of the films were permanently removed from DMM/R18, meaning that entries like GASO-0068 (starring Kaho Shibuya) are lost in time unless somebody scoops up a DVD somewhere for an SD quality rip. For that reason, unlike other series, I have included compilation movies in here. That way, there's at least a chance of glimpsing hints of those lost movies. Some movies are also inexplicably only available in SD. Yeah, DMM isn't the greatest service, big surprise, I know.

**1080p**: GAOR-087, GAOR-088, GAOR-089, GAOR-090, GAOR-091, GAOR-092, GAOR-093, GAOR-094, GAOR-095, GAOR-096, GAOR-097, GAOR-098, GAOR-099, GAOR-100, GAOR-101, GAOR-102, GAOR-103, GAOR-104, GAOR-105, GAOR-106, GAOR-107, GAOR-108, GAOR-109, GAOR-110, GAOR-111, GAOR-112, GAOR-113, GAOR-114, GAOR-115, GAOR-116, GAOR-117, GAOR-118, GAOR-119, GAOR-120, GAOR-121, GASO-0009, GASO-0010, GASO-0018, GASO-0019, GASO-0021, GASO-0022, GASO-0023, GASO-0026, GASO-0038, GASO-0039, GASO-0042, GASO-0043, GASO-0045, GASO-0047, GASO-0048, GASO-0053, GASO-0056, GASO-0061, GASO-0067, GASO-0072, GASO-0073, GASO-0074, GASO-0075, GASO-0076, GASO-0077, GASO-0078, GASO-0079, GASO-0080, GASO-0082

**720p**: GASO-0003, GASO-0004, GASO-0013, GASO-0014

**404p**: GAOR-083, GAOR-084, GAOR-085, GAOR-086

All movies in this pack feature a single actress each, bar GAOR-111 and the compilations (GAOR-086, GAOR-108, GAOR-120). They all follow almost the exact same formula, so if you like one, you'll likely enjoy the rest too, as long as you like the actress. It's one of two setups: either you get woken up in your apartment as your girlfriend wakes up beside you (and often rides your tired body for good morning sex), or you meet up with her somewhere outside, for a date. Those dates usually include a walk through a park (with heavily blurred out background, because Japanese laws), then some sort of activity (e.g. baseball cages, arcade), followed by some of your girlfriend's best cooking back home (MY DICK) and after you get catered to by your girlfriend/wife, she models a small bikini for you on your bed. It always finishes up with straight up sex in missionary. In between, there's often a bathing scene together focussing on handjobs. GAOR-111 is a bit of an odd-one out; it features two actresses at once, and specifically on their breasts. Thus, there's a lot of extra titfucking, and even some slightly lesbian interactions between the two (mostly some boob groping), but the main attraction is still all happening on a dildo in a quasi POV scenario.

Covers and screens are in albums. They're sorted (like the description) by release date, but also have the code in the description underneath the picture, since covers are sometimes too low-res to read the code reliably.
